phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Technology & Business Foundations — Build digital literacy, explore IT career pathways, and develop professional identity.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and BIT career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to BIT career pathways including business analytics, IT consulting, systems analysis, cybersecurity, and project management.

milestones.label: Master information systems fundamentals
milestones.description: Survey of information systems concepts including hardware, software, networking, databases, and the role of IT in modern business operations. Students explore emerging technologies and digital transformation trends.

milestones.label: Build programming foundations
milestones.description: Introduction to programming logic and Python for business applications. Students write scripts for data processing, automation, and basic analytics to solve real business problems.

milestones.label: Join Association for Information Systems student chapter
milestones.description: Join the AIS student chapter, ACM student group, or CoBE Technology Club. Attend hackathons, tech talks, and networking events with IT professionals and alumni.

milestones.label: Analyze digital transformation in global business
milestones.description: Examine how digital technologies are transforming industries globally, from e-commerce and fintech to cloud computing and AI-driven business models across different economic contexts.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Database & Systems Analysis — Build database management and systems analysis skills for enterprise IT roles.

milestones.label: Master database management systems
milestones.description: Relational database design, SQL programming, normalization, and data modeling. Students design and implement a database solution for a real business scenario using MySQL or SQL Server.

milestones.label: Learn systems analysis and design methodologies
milestones.description: Study the systems development life cycle (SDLC), requirements gathering, UML modeling, and agile methodologies. Students analyze a real business process and design an IT solution.

milestones.label: Attend CoBE career fair and tech industry recruiting events
milestones.description: Participate in career fairs and tech recruiting events with IT consulting firms, enterprise software companies, and corporate IT departments. Practice technical interviewing skills.

milestones.label: Study business data analytics and visualization
milestones.description: Apply statistical analysis and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) to business datasets. Students analyze real-world business data to support decision-making across industries.

milestones.label: Master web development technologies
milestones.description: Full-stack web development including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and server-side frameworks. Students build functional web applications addressing real business requirements.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced IT & Professional Certification — Master enterprise systems, earn industry certifications, and gain professional experience.

milestones.label: Study enterprise resource planning systems
milestones.description: Study ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and their role in integrating business processes across finance, HR, supply chain, and operations. Students complete SAP certification modules.

milestones.label: Study cybersecurity and IT governance
milestones.description: Network security, risk assessment, compliance frameworks (NIST, SOX, GDPR), and IT governance. Students conduct security assessments and develop organizational security policies.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an IT industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with an IT professional, systems architect, or IT consultant through CoBE networks. Monthly meetings focus on technology career paths, certifications, and industry trends.

milestones.label: Complete summer IT internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship in IT consulting, business analytics, systems administration, or software development. Apply technical and analytical skills in a professional setting.

milestones.label: Study IT project management
milestones.description: Master IT project management methodologies (PMI, Scrum, Kanban) and tools. Students manage a team-based IT project from inception through delivery, applying both waterfall and agile approaches.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Complete capstone IT project, earn certifications, and launch technology career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone IT consulting project
milestones.description: Collaborate with a client organization to analyze IT challenges, design system solutions, and deliver a working prototype or strategic recommendations. Projects are evaluated by faculty and industry professionals.

milestones.label: Earn industry certification (CompTIA, AWS, or Salesforce)
milestones.description: Prepare for and earn an industry-recognized certification such as CompTIA Security+, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Salesforce Administrator, or Google Analytics. Certification enhances employability and validates technical competency.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and tech community leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in BIT coursework, lead hackathon teams, and contribute to the campus tech community through workshops, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

milestones.label: Develop tech industry placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package targeting IT consulting, analytics, or tech company roles. Includes technical portfolio, GitHub profile, certification documentation, and industry contact network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE BIT Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate school admissions, or certification achievements.
